excerpt: MAGIC is a system of two IACTs, separated by a distance of 85 m. ... LST-1 ... is located in Observatorio Roque de los Muchachos, La Palma (Spain), at the altitude of 2200 m a.s.l.. It is placed at a distance of only ~100 m from the MAGIC telescopes.
publisher: LST Collaboration and MAGIC Collaboration (Astronomy & Astrophysics, 2023)
title: Performance of the joint LST-1 and MAGIC observations evaluated with Crab Nebula data
